boundary_source.attribution: U.S. Census Bureau, 2025 TIGER/Line Shapefiles. Public domain U.S. government data.
boundary_source.boundary_edge_model: Coordinate-linear edges through transformed source vertices in longitude/latitude; original vertex count, islands, holes and water retained; no simplification.
boundary_source.coverage: 50 United States and Washington, DC; no territories
boundary_source.name: U.S. Census Bureau TIGER/Line States

transformation.notes: Area-aware component operations fixed at build time without optional grids. Published operation accuracy is not a surveyed boundary guarantee. BALLPARK components have unknown datum accuracy.

BALLPARK.area: Components outside available published operation areas
BALLPARK.name: Explicit approximate NAD83/WGS84 coordinate equivalence
BALLPARK.notes: Source coordinates retained under an approximate datum-equivalence convention. Accuracy is unknown, not four meters. No region-specific transformation is claimed.
